task: Erdos #776 and #256 Round12 original-target proof work

new_all_parameter_results: The original three units produce strong-minus-original defect gaps 6, M+4, and binom(M-7,2)+4M-21 in the first three compared transitions for M>=14.
The original endpoint is equivalent to E_3<=binom(M-1,3)+28.
The endpoint is equivalently a quadratic forward-slack target S_(M-5)>=binom(M-3,2)-378 for M>=32, provided along the exact nonnegative branch.
Before the first carry, the quadratic slack has an exact canonical normal form controlled by x_3=5 and x_(j+1)=binom(x_j,2)-2j+3; its first values are 5, 7, 16, 113, 6319, and 19961710.
The intervals I_j=[x_(j-1)+2j-6,x_j+2j-5], j>=4, partition every V>=7 and classify exactly the rank and legal post-carry canonical form of the first carry.
The first-carry rank is log_2(log V)+O(1), from x_j^2/4<=x_(j+1)<x_j^2/2 for j>=5.
At that first carry, S_j-binom(V,j)>=binom(V-2j+7,3)=(1/6+o(1))V^3 uniformly, so the original three-unit perturbation still leaves a cubic reservoir; survival through later blocks is unproved.
For every 6329<=V<=19961721, the first carry occurs at rank 8 and has an explicit legal post-carry normal form with rank-2 residual y=19961710-(V-11).
The next full-interval split is exact: V*=19840461 is the unique rank-9 threshold U_2(y)>=V, and both sides have explicit legal canonical normal forms.

A carry-independent backward block requirement B_(L+1)=0, B_k=KK_(k+1)(V+B_(k+1)) is equivalent to residual survival through any fixed separated block; for L=3 its next exact threshold is V**=19838163.

For V>=379, with F_5=binom(V+1,5)+binom(V-1,4)+binom(V-2,3), the original endpoint condition is exactly equivalent to the fixed residual bound E_5-F_5<=binom(376,2)=70500; proving that uniform bound remains open.
For V>=70501, that fixed rank-5 bound is exactly equivalent to F_6-E_6>=binom(V-4,2)-binom(70496,2), an explicit quadratic rank-6 target.

finite_exact_witness.scope: one exact finite parameter; no extrapolation

results.translation_to_original: An all-M proof of the original endpoint would give n_0(r)<=2r+5 and, with the repository lower bound, equality for r>=11. That all-M carry bound is not proved here.
results.remaining_gap: Prove the fixed rank-5 residual bound E_5-F_5<=70500 for all V>=379 (equivalently control every earlier carry), or find an original-start counterexample.

results.new_all_parameter_result: For every odd prime p, a nonzero residue multiset has a two-support product in Z[C_p] iff, for some t and signed class D, class D occurs 2t+1 times and every other signed class occurs 2t times.
results.low_energy_consequence: If p divides exactly m exponents, 0<m<n, and E(A)<6m, then s-1=t(p-1) and the outside signed-residue histogram has exactly that form.
results.strict_no_go: Primitive prime cyclic projection alone cannot exclude all compatible low-energy branches, because every classified histogram is realizable.
results.multi_prime_marginal_no_go: For every finite set of odd primes, CRT constructs one exponent multiset simultaneously realizing a t=1 compatible signed histogram at every prime; marginal histogram constraints alone cannot yield a contradiction (no low-energy claim is made for that construction).
results.degenerate_branch_recursion: When t=0, necessarily s=1 and E(pc_1,...,pc_m,b)=2E(c_1,...,c_m) exactly for p not dividing b.
results.translation_to_original: Conditional structural theorem only; no universal lower-bound improvement for f(n).
results.remaining_gap: A universal prime/CRT/full-fibre/Archimedean bridge for arbitrary exponent multisets.
